Tesseract.js 7.0.0 (Apache-2.0), source https://github.com/naptha/tesseract.js
Tesseract.js-core 6.1.2 (Apache-2.0), source https://github.com/naptha/tesseract.js-core
English tessdata_fast language model (Apache-2.0), source https://github.com/tesseract-ocr/tessdata_fast

Core .wasm.js variants embed their WASM bytes. Keep all four variants so the reader can choose a supported engine. The language model is served as eng.traineddata.gz. OCR runs on the device. These assets are loaded and cached only when photo reading is used.
